# FreeInk PaperMono board service provenance

Vendored verbatim from FreeInk commit
`310ec61506fc915836db7799a2e7f4fc135a570d`:

- `libs/hardware/BoardConfig/include/PaperMonoBoard.h`
- `libs/hardware/BoardConfig/include/M5Pm1.h`
- `libs/hardware/BoardConfig/include/M5Ioe1.h`

The source is licensed under the adjacent MIT `LICENSE`. This vendor boundary
is limited to the PaperMono PM1/IOE1 bootstrap and its known-safe output-state
configuration; no FreeInk UI, display driver, touch, or SD component is used.
